formula: Prevalence ~ Length + Depth + Sex + Stage + Age + Year + (1 | Area)
notes: RULE GAP: Prevalence is binary; repeated Area is retained as a proposed cluster. Chapter 10 fits Prevalence ~ factor(Area)*factor(Year) + Length as a binomial GLM and later smooths Length; neither establishes this random-Area formula.

formula: 15N ~ Age + (1 | Tooth)
notes: RULE GAP: The continuous 15N measurements repeat within Tooth. Chapter 7 fits tooth-specific Age smooths and fixed Tooth differences, optionally with within-Tooth Gaussian residual correlation; the common linear Age effect and random Tooth intercept are inferred.

formula: nlme::lme(IntakeRate ~ fSex, random=~1|fID, weights=nlme::varIdent(form=~1|fSex*fPeriod), method="REML", data=transform(Limosa, fSex=factor(Sex), fPeriod=factor(Period), fID=factor(ID)))
notes: Chapter 7 final M4.lme fits a Gaussian random-ID model with Sex in the mean and Sex-by-Period residual variance strata. AGE, Bplumage and mean Period are absent. The diagnostic plot labels ID as Day; individual-bird identification is not established.

formula: nlme::lme(log10(Spobee+1) ~ fInfection01, random=~1|fHive, weights=nlme::varIdent(form=~1|fInfection01), method="REML", data=transform(Bees, fInfection01=factor(Infection>0), fHive=factor(Hive)))
notes: Chapter 19 final Mfinal fits Gaussian log10(Spobee+1), binary infection presence, a Hive intercept and infection-specific residual variances. BeesN is removed; there is no final random slope.

formula: Abun ~ WeekTime + Timeofday + Windspeed + Weather + (1 | Site)
notes: RULE GAP: Abun is a raw count and Site repeats. Chapter 23 compares a Gaussian GAMM with a Month-by-time-of-day smooth, wind-direction recoding, fixed Site and seasonal residual variances against a Poisson GLM with polynomial and interaction terms; neither establishes this random-Site formula.

formula: Richness ~ ROCK + LITTER + BARESOIL + FallPrec + SprTmax + Time + (1 | Transect)
notes: RULE GAP: Richness is a raw count and Transect repeats. Chapter 3 fits a Gaussian-default GAM with separate smooths of ROCK, LITTER, BARESOIL, FallPrec and SprTmax, without Time or a Transect random effect; this mixed formula is inferred.

formula: presence ~ scale(pprim_ssite) + scale(psec_ssite) + scale(phss_1km) + scale(pm_1km) + (1 | site)
notes: Chapter 21 Model_Best is a binomial-logit GLMM with site intercepts and these four standardized habitat predictors; the other habitat metrics are absent from the final fit.

formula: AQBIRDS ~ SPTREAT + DEPTH + AREA + Time + (1 | FIELD)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: waterbird use of rice fields under straw treatments, fields repeated over time within site. Aggregate aquatic-bird density (AQBIRDS) taken as the response; the ~50 per-species density columns and the other aggregates are alternate responses in ignore. Field nested in site. low. SITE holds one level (4mile) in the loaded table, so FIELD is the only grouping factor; SITE ignored (merge refusal, corrected 2026-10-08).

formula: N_days ~ Species + Size_cm + PDayRain + Tot_Rain + Temp_avg + Season + (1 | Road)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED / RULE GAP: snake road-mortality records, several snakes per road. N_days (carcass persistence) taken as the response vs rain/temperature/size; Road the spatial cluster per the #24 repeating-cluster rule. Response and grouping inferred -> low.

formula: Nauplii ~ Volume + Depth + Production_week + Month + (1 | Station)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Nauplii is retained as a proposed count response, with repeated Station as the cluster; stations include A, C, E, F and G. Chapter 9 instead models Copepod, using log Volume as an offset, Production_week smooths by Depth and fixed Station. The filed Nauplii formula is not a documented chapter fit.

formula: Signs_in_yard ~ No_setts_in_fields + factor(Sugarbeet) + (1 | farm_code_numeric); fitted to the BadgersFarmSurveysNoNA subset
notes: Chapter 22 switches to BadgersFarmSurveysNoNA before fitting. Its last selected binomial GLMM uses No_setts_in_fields, categorical Sugarbeet and a farm intercept; the earlier selected fit uses Accessible_feed_store_present instead.

formula: Richness ~ Hlog10 + Treespecies + Sitetype + Ageclass + GroundVeg + HerbLayer + ShrubLayer + MeanLitterDepth + (1 | Plot)
notes: RULE GAP: Richness is a count and Plot is a repeated cluster. Chapter 4 documents linear mixed models and discusses random slopes, but its password-protected code was not read; this exact covariate subset and random-slope specification remain unverified. Retain the filed formula only as a proposal, not a fully hand-verified published model.

formula: PA ~ CellSize + (1 | Hive)
notes: RULE GAP: PA is binary, with no trials column, and Hive repeats. The public contents place the honeybee-parasite example in the binomial GLM section. The password-protected chapter code was not read, so this exact random-Hive formula remains an unverified proposal.

formula: Dandelion ~ Treatment + Time + (1 | Hive)
notes: Zuur Beginner's Guide to GLM/GLMM (2013): dandelion pollen collected by honeybee hives over four times, repeated measures per hive (random hive). Exact model inferred -> low; Unnamed: 4 is an empty column.

formula: leaves ~ crown.mm + diam.1 + diam.2 + (1 | Genus) + (1 | Genus:Species)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Leaf count is a proposed response with Species nested within Genus. Year is constant at 2004 and is omitted. The book’s chapter 6 concerns biomass/Gamma models; this leaf-count model is not verified as a published fit.

formula: NEggs ~ NLowBranches + TreeHeight + HerbCover + Shelter + BuckthornAbundance + BrambleAbundance + SmallOakAbundance + Distance2Edge + NearestTallOak + (1 | Area)
notes: RULE GAP: NEggs is a count response and Area is a repeated cluster. Chapter 15 explicitly includes a Poisson GLMM and ZAP models with random effects. The exact full predictor set in the filed formula was not verified from the password-protected code; retain it as a proposal.

formula: BMS10mg ~ OriginAltitude + GardenAltitude + InitSize + Soil + (1 | Location) + (1 | Garden) + (1 | Garden:Bed)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: BMS10mg is retained as a continuous proposed response. Origin Location crosses Garden, with Bed nested within Garden. The exact shoot/stem interpretation of BMS10mg and this additive fixed part were not independently verified from chapter code; chapter 9 describes reproductive indices with nested and crossed random effects.

formula: Kiwi ~ Treatment + Time + (1 | Hive)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: honeybee pollen collection over four times per hive (as in pollen.txt). Kiwi pollen count taken as the response vs treatment and time, random hive; the other colour counts and TotalWeight are alternate responses. low.

formula: Totalparasites ~ LT + LS + Weight + SEX + (1 | Location)
notes: RULE GAP: Totalparasites is a count response and repeated Location is retained under the cluster convention. The author’s follow-up analysis of this table selects LT after finding collinearity with LS and Weight, and fits a GLM with SEX, LT, fixed Location and LT-by-Location. The exact earlier ZIM code remains unread; no direct support was established for the filed all-predictor random-Location formula or its zero-inflated attribution.

formula: log(AFD) ~ LNLENGTH + (1 | MONTH)
notes: RULE GAP: The response is raw AFD, continuous, with log(AFD) in the proposed formula and repeated MONTH retained as a cluster. The accessible chapter 2 code fits lm(LNAFD ~ LNLENGTH*factor(MONTH)); the earlier chapter 4 GLS attribution was not substantiated. The table contains six observed months. This random-MONTH model remains inferred.

formula: Heteropoda ~ Blattodea_dw + Orthoptera_dw + Ti_dw + SoilMoisture + LogLeaf + Distance + Season + (1 | Site)
notes: Row 3 of the multivariate filing (one row per spider taxon), see model_index 1. Hand sample #61: as #1 and #2, chapter 6 documents Poisson GLMs and a hurdle (ZAP) analysis, not this random-site GLMM.

formula: nlme::lme(Age ~ fStain*fLocation, random=~1|fSpecies/fDolphinID, weights=nlme::varIdent(form=~1|fLocation), method="REML", data=transform(subset(Cetaceans, Sex != 0), fStain=factor(Stain), fLocation=factor(Location), fSpecies=factor(Species), fDolphinID=factor(DolphinID)))
notes: Chapter 20 final M3 fits Gaussian Age with Stain-by-Location fixed effects, nested Species/DolphinID intercepts and location-specific residual variances, excluding Sex=0. The full Sex-by-Stain-by-Location model is fitted earlier, but Sex and its interactions are removed from the final fit.
